subject: organic
question: 有机化学·Reaction Learn 命名反应学习卡：请用文字概述该反应的主要转化：Copper-catalysed azide–alkyne cycloaddition。 来源卡片给出的代表性条件：CuSO₄, sodium ascorbate, t-BuOH/H₂O。
answer: Cu(I) catalyses the [3+2] cycloaddition of an azide and a terminal alkyne to a 1,4-disubstituted 1,2,3-triazole.
explanation: 来源补充说明（未专家审核）：The best-known click reaction. Without copper (Huisgen) it needs heat and gives both regioisomers.
